acceptance: The source of the NaN is identified, with a minimal reproduction.
The 22-query rows-against-Arrow parity on chDB matches 22 of 22, on the locked version if it can load, otherwise the version used is recorded.
chDB's fetch_mode default follows the parity result.
description:
Found in the Arrow fetch work (#4012) on chDB 3.7.2. Rows-against-Arrow digest parity over the 22 TPC-H SF0.01 queries matched 21 of 22. Q17 returns NaN on the rows path and NULL on the Arrow path. Arrow therefore stays opt-in for ClickHouse local mode. The locked chDB 4.1.6 wheel does not load on this macOS, so the parity run used 3.7.2 (see chdb-4x-engine-load-verification-20261006).

One of the two paths misrepresents an empty-aggregate result. That affects result digests and validation for chDB in rows mode, which is the current default.

Change. Determine the SQL-correct value for Q17's output on that data (NULL for AVG over an empty set) and where NaN is introduced: the chDB driver, BenchBox's row conversion, or a settings difference. Fix the wrong path, re-run the 22-query parity, and switch chDB's default to Arrow if all 22 match.
